# Frequency Lists by Neri

> > Comprehensive frequency-based language learning resources featuring word lists, sentence collections, and Anki decks for Spanish, German, and other languages.

Created by Neri, this site provides data-driven vocabulary lists and graded sentences sourced from Wiktionary and Tatoeba, designed to optimize language acquisition through frequency-based learning. Resources include downloadable Anki decks and study methodology guides.

## Key Topics

- Frequency lists
- Anki decks
- Spanish vocabulary
- German vocabulary
- Tatoeba sentences
- Wiktionary data
- Most common words
- Vocabulary acquisition
- Sentence sorting by difficulty
- Language learning methodology
- Word frequency analysis
- Beginner to advanced progression
- Verb conjugation lists
- Contextual learning

## Spanish Language Resources

- [The 8600 Most Frequently Used Spanish Words](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2016/05/the-8600-most-frequently-used-spanish.html): 8600 most frequent Spanish words with Anki deck and study methods
- [The 1000 Most Frequently Used Spanish Words](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2015/08/the-1000-most-frequently-used-spanish.html): Top 1000 Spanish words by frequency with ANKI deck for study
- [1000 Spanish Words Sorted by Frequency of Use](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2017/06/1000-spanish-words-sorted-by-frequency.html): 1000 Spanish words by frequency with etymology from Wiktionary
- [The 500 Most Frequently Used Spanish Words](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2016/05/the-500-most-frequently-used-spanish.html): 500 most common Spanish words using Wiktionary and Tatoeba data
- [The 100 Most Frequently Used Spanish Words + 1000~ Example Sentences](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2015/08/the-100-most-frequently-used-spanish.html): 100 most common Spanish words with 1000+ example sentences
- [The 3700 Most Frequently Used Spanish Words (No Verbs)](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2016/05/the-3700-most-frequently-used-spanish.html): 3700 most frequent Spanish words excluding verbs from Wiktionary/Tatoeba
- [Most Frequently Used Spanish Verbs](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2015/05/300-most-frequently-used-spanish-verbs.html): Most common Spanish verbs frequency list for vocabulary learning

## German Language Resources

- [5000 German Sentences Sorted from Easiest to Hardest](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2016/08/german-sentences-sorted-from-easiest-to.html): 5000 German sentences from Tatoeba sorted by difficulty with Anki deck
- [The 2980 Most Frequently Used German Nouns (With Plural)](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2016/01/the-2980-most-frequently-used-german.html): 2980 most frequent German nouns with plural forms for language learning
- [The 2000 Most Frequent German Nouns](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2015/12/the-2000-most-frequent-german-nouns.html): 2000 most common German nouns for vocabulary learning

## Graded Sentence Collections

- [5000 Turkish Sentences Sorted from Easiest to Hardest](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2016/08/5000-turkish-sentences-sorted-from.html): 5000 Turkish sentences sorted by difficulty with Anki deck
- [5000 Russian Sentences Sorted from Easiest to Hardest](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2016/08/5000-russian-sentences-sorted-from.html): 5000 Russian sentences sorted by difficulty for progressive learning

## Asian Language Resources

- [The 2000 Most Frequently Used Mandarin Chinese Nouns](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2015/12/the-2000-most-frequently-used-mandarin.html): 2000 most frequent Mandarin Chinese nouns for vocabulary learning
- [The 2000 Most Frequently Used Japanese Nouns](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2015/12/the-2000-most-frequently-used-japanese.html): Top 2000 Japanese nouns by frequency for vocabulary acquisition

## Learning Methodology & Guides

- [Study Hints](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2015/09/study-hints.html): Study tips for language learning using YouTube, Google Translate, typing tools
- [The Problem with Frequency Dictionaries](https://frequencylists.blogspot.com/2015/09/the-problem-with-frequency-dictionaries.html): Critique of frequency dictionaries and contextual learning approach
